facts.fact_text: The applicant was convicted on account of his participation in a demonstration held in Batman on 13 December 2009.
The Diyarbakır Assize Court established that the applicant had taken part in the demonstration of 13 December 2009.
The demonstration of 13 December 2009 was allegedly organised by the PKK (Kurdish Workers' Party, an illegal armed organisation).
The Diyarbakır Assize Court established that the applicant had been part of a group of demonstrators who chanted slogans in favour of the PKK (Kurdish Workers' Party).
The Diyarbakır Assize Court established that the applicant had been part of a group of demonstrators who chanted slogans in favour of Abdullah Öcalan, the leader of the PKK (Kurdish Workers' Party).
The application concerns the conviction of the applicant under Articles 220 § 6 and 314 of the Turkish Criminal Code.
The applicant was convicted on account of his participation in a demonstration held in Batman on 13 December 2009.
The applicant was sentenced to six years and three months' imprisonment under Articles 220 § 6 and 314 of the Turkish Criminal Code.
On 13 December 2009 the applicant was taken into police custody.
On 16 December 2009 the applicant was placed in pre-trial detention.

On 8 June 2010 the Diyarbakır Assize Court convicted the applicant of committing offenses in the name of an illegal organisation without being a member of it pursuant to Article 314 § 2 of the Turkish Criminal Code, on the basis of Articles 220 § 6 and 314 § 3 of the same Code.
The Diyarbakır Assize Court sentenced the applicant to six years and three months' imprisonment on 8 June 2010.

The Diyarbakır Assize Court convicted the applicant of membership of an illegal organisation on the basis that he was considered to have committed a crime on behalf of an illegal organisation and acted in breach of the Meetings and Demonstration Marches Act (Law no. 2911).
On 2 August 2012 the Diyarbakır Assize Court finally sentenced the applicant to imprisonment for a period of three years, one month and fifteen days.

On 13 January 2010 the Batman public prosecutor issued an indictment charging the applicant with committing offenses in the name of an illegal organisation without being a member of it, under section 23(b) of the Meetings and Demonstration Marches Act (Law no. 2911).

On 13 January 2010 the Batman public prosecutor issued an indictment charging the applicant with resisting the security forces by way of throwing stones, under section 33(c) of the Meetings and Demonstration Marches Act (Law no. 2911).

On 8 June 2010 the Diyarbakır Assize Court convicted the applicant of committing offenses in the name of an illegal organisation without being a member of it pursuant to Article 314 § 2 of the Turkish Criminal Code, on the basis of Articles 220 § 6 and 314 § 3 of the same Code.
The Diyarbakır Assize Court concluded that the applicant's conduct constituted the offence prescribed by Section 32 of the Meetings and Demonstration Marches Act (Law no. 2911).

The Diyarbakır Assize Court convicted the applicant of membership of an illegal organisation on the basis that he was considered to have committed a crime on behalf of an illegal organisation and acted in breach of the Meetings and Demonstration Marches Act (Law no. 2911).
On 5 July 2012 Law no. 6352 entered into force.
Law no. 6352 amended various laws with a view to suspending proceedings and sentences given in cases concerning crimes committed through the press and media and similar expressions of opinions.

On 2 August 2012 the Diyarbakır Assize Court, hearing the applicant's request to benefit from Law no. 6352, decided to reduce the sentence imposed on the applicant by half, taking into account the amendment made by Law no. 6352 to Article 220 § 6 of the Turkish Criminal Code.
On 2 August 2012 the Diyarbakır Assize Court finally sentenced the applicant to imprisonment for a period of three years, one month and fifteen days.
